content_data.project_title: AI-Driven Credit Risk Scoring Model Enhancement
content_data.project_description: Proposing an initiative to significantly enhance our long-term credit risk scoring capabilities through the integration of advanced predictive analytics and alternative data sources, aiming for improved accuracy and reduced default rates in our fintech lending products.
content_data.timeline: 15 months, structured into three distinct phases over the next period.
content_data.project_lead: Dr. Anya Sharma, Senior Financial Analyst
objectives: Reduce non-performing loan (NPL) rates by 5-7% over the next two years through better risk assessment.
Automate 70% of the model validation and monitoring processes over the project duration.
deliverables: Full model integration plan and API documentation for existing lending platforms.
Developed and validated AI-driven credit risk scoring model prototype within nine months.
Comprehensive feasibility study and data source assessment report within the initial three months.
risk_analysis: Availability of specialized AI/ML engineering talent for implementation (Medium).
Integration complexity with existing legacy systems and data infrastructure (Medium-High).
